name: Divisibility Check
description: You are given an array of integers. Check whether there exists a number in this array which is divisible by all other numbers in this array. Output 1 , if such a number exists, and 0 otherwise.
input_specification: The only line of the input contains a list of space-separated integers a i ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 100 ) — elements of the array. The size of the array is between 2 and 10 , inclusive. Note that the size of the array is not given explicitly!
output_specification: Output 1 if there exists element of this array which is divisible by all other elements of the array, and 0 otherwise.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
